Answer: C
Reason: The axial CT image demonstrates a well-circumscribed anterior mediastinal mass containing a distinct, thick calcified rim and internal heterogeneous density (fat/soft tissue), which are pathognomonic features of a mature teratoma. While the patient has a history of breast cancer, the specific radiological appearance of calcification and mixed composition strongly favors a benign teratoma over metastasis or other solid tumors.
